summary_1line: Krishna explains Kshetra (body/matter) and Kshetrajna (knower/spirit), true knowledge, the nature of Brahman, and liberation through understanding spirit distinct from nature.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna reveals the cosmic presence of the Supreme with countless eyes, heads, and hands pervading the entire universe.
A radiant sun illuminates the whole world as a metaphor for the Spirit lighting up all matter.
Krishna teaching Arjuna on the battlefield while describing the body as a field and the self as its knower.
